definitions.gloss: to jump up; to spring up; to leap into the air
definitions.explanation: To move upward suddenly by jumping, often from surprise, joy, or excitement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嬉|うれ}しくて→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{飛|と}び{上|あ}がった。
⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧{飛|と}び{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I jumped up, startled by the loud noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{上|あ}がって⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The children jumped up and down with delight.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Compound verb: ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧.

NUANCE: Often used to express emotional reactions like surprise or joy, rather than deliberate physical movement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる: to jump for joy
・⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる: to jump up in surprise
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がって⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧: to be overjoyed (jumping with happiness)

IDIOMATIC:
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧: so happy one could jump for joy
